title: How to Get Free Gym Trials in NZ — Every Major Chain's Trial Policy
meta_desc: Discover how to get free gym trials in NZ with every major chain's trial policy, including Les Mills, Anytime Fitness, and more
intro: Before committing to a gym membership, trying out a gym with a free trial pass can be a great way to test the facilities and equipment. With prices ranging from $15 to $30 per week, it's essential to find the right fit. In this guide, we'll explore the trial policies of major NZ gym chains.

sections.heading: Les Mills Free Trial
sections.body: Les Mills offers a 5-day free trial at most of its 12 locations across NZ, including Auckland, Wellington, and Christchurch. This trial gives you access to their group fitness classes and equipment.

sections.heading: Anytime Fitness Trial Policy
sections.body: Anytime Fitness provides a 7-day free trial at over 50 locations nationwide. You can try out their 24/7 access, cardio equipment, and free weights during this period.

sections.heading: Jetts Gym Trial
sections.body: Jetts Gym offers a 3-day free trial at its 18 locations across NZ. You can experience their no-contract membership, 24/7 access, and state-of-the-art equipment during this time.

sections.heading: CityFitness Free Trial
sections.body: CityFitness offers a 7-day free trial at its 13 locations across NZ. You can try out their group fitness classes, including yoga and Pilates, during this period.

sections.heading: Get the Best Value Gym Membership
sections.body: With so many options available, it's essential to compare prices and trial policies before committing to a gym membership. You can compare prices and find the best value gym membership on our website.
